```artifact
Feature: Self-Test Suite for Unit U14_Self_Test

  Scenario: Test accuracy of the O2 sensor
    Given the O2 sensor is initialized
    When the self-test is run
    Then the O2 sensor accuracy should be validated
    And the test should pass if the accuracy is within the specified range

  Scenario: Validate blower response
    Given the blower is initialized
    And the blower speed is set to a specific value
    When the self-test is run
    Then the pressure achieved at that speed should be validated
    And the test should pass if the pressure is within the specified range

  Scenario: Validate pinch valves pressure response
    Given the blower is initialized
    And the blower speed is set to a specific value
    And the pinch valves are in a specific state
    When the self-test is run
    Then the pressure response of the pinch valves should be validated
    And the test should pass if the pressure is within the specified range

  Scenario: Validate audible alarm devices
    Given the audible alarm devices are initialized
    And the system is powered on
    When the self-test is run
    Then the audible alarm devices should be validated
    And the test should pass if the alarms are audible

  Scenario: Validate visual alarms
    Given the visual alarms are initialized
    And the system is powered on
    When the self-test is run
    Then the visual alarms should be validated
    And the test should pass if the alarms are visible
```
